_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 11, Topics 11.1-11.7. Topic/sub-topic names and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns are omitted for the same reason documented in the Grade 10 file. This grade has a systemic numbering-prefix problem in the source document: entire blocks of outcomes are printed under the wrong topic code, consistently shifted from their true topic. Every outcome below has been renumbered to match its true topic (identified from the printed Topic heading itself, and cross-checked against the syllabus's own Appendix One 'Scope and Sequence Chart', which independently confirms each topic's real theme and grade placement); the printed source code is noted per case. Topic 11.1 (The Zambian Bill of Rights): outcomes printed as 12.1.1-12.1.4, renumbered 11.1.1-11.1.4. Topic 11.2 (Civil Society and Media in Governance): outcomes printed as 11.1.1-11.1.7 (with 11.1.7 itself printed twice for two different outcomes), renumbered 11.2.1-11.2.8; this topic does have two real named sub-topics in the source table ('Civil Society and governance' and 'Media and Governance'), reproduced here. Topic 11.3 (Economic and Social Development): outcomes printed as 11.2.1-11.2.8, renumbered 11.3.1-11.3.8. Topic 11.4 (Zambia's Legal System): outcomes printed with several internal duplicates/out-of-order codes (11.4.1 x2, 11.4.3 x2, then 11.4.6, 11.4.7, 11.4.5 printed in that order at the end), renumbered 11.4.1-11.4.9 in the document's own printed reading order, which content-cross-checks cleanly against the adjacent Content column. Topic 11.7 (Child Abuse): outcomes printed as 11.6.1-11.6.9, renumbered 11.7.1-11.7.9; this topic has three real named sub-topics in the source table ('Child abuse', 'Sexual harassment', 'Teenage pregnancies'), reproduced here. Topics 11.5 (Gender Equity and Equality) and 11.6 (Culture of Peace) were printed correctly with no numbering issues. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 11 is modeled as a single term here.
